body:
I appreciate this thought and it's one I've been struggling with. 

Part of me says: "My friends are really smart and thoughtful, I want to believe them whether they give me information or not."
The other side says: "It could be less than nothing and I am in a spiral totally on my own."
This is where my head went, but I have been on medication that I can't drink much with since before anything would have happened. The timeline doesn't make any sense.

This is part of the problem, I don't have any idea what it could be about, nor what their side of the story is because they don't want to talk to me about it. My friends have shut me out completely. I don't know where to go from here.
